intro.title: Triads
intro.text: A triad is three notes a 3rd apart: root, 3rd, 5th. Here you play them one note at a time (broken), up and down.

intro.title: Major and minor
intro.text: C, F and G are major (bright). D, E and A are minor (darker): their middle note is one key lower. The left hand plays each root.

parts.lh: C3/w | D3/w | E3/w | F3/w | G3/w | A3/w | G3/w | C3/w
